description_en: Queries the delivery trace of a message by Message ID
description_zh: 根据 Message ID 查询消息的投递轨迹信息
kebab_example: aliyun sofa get-mq-sofamq-trace-by-msg-id --begin-time 1570852800 --cell RZ01A --end-time 1570968000 --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --msg-id 1E05791C117818B4AAC23B1BB0CE0000 --topic test --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMqSofamqTraceByMsgId
